profile.headline: CRM Specialist | Web Developer/Designer | Automation Developer | SEO Specialist
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Alvyn 👋

I help businesses improve their website, CRM, automations, and SEO so they can get more leads, save time, and convert better.

I usually work with teams that already have the pieces in place, but things feel messy. The website needs fixes. The CRM is not organized. Follow-ups are too manual. SEO is not moving. Or the tools are not talking to each other properly.

That’s where I come in.

🌐 Web Design & Development
I build, fix, and improve websites using WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, and custom HTML/CSS/JS.

I can help with landing pages, website redesigns, Shopify product pages, WordPress builds, mobile responsiveness, speed fixes, layout issues, bug fixes, and conversion improvements.

Tools/builders I work with include Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, and Breakdance.

📌 CRM Setup & Cleanup
I help clean up and organize CRMs so leads are easier to track and follow up with.

I work with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Pipedrive, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, and Salesforce.

This can include pipeline setup, lead source tracking, contact segmentation, forms, calendars, follow-up workflows, and sales process cleanup.

⚙️ Automations & Integrations
I build automations that remove repetitive tasks and keep the process moving.

Tools I use include Make.com, Zapier, n8n, Pabbly, Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, webhooks, and API integrations.

I can help connect forms to CRMs, send lead notifications, create tasks, trigger email/SMS follow-ups, automate reports, and connect third-party apps.

📈 SEO & Website Growth
I help improve website visibility through technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, and content optimization.

I work with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, RankMath, Yoast, and Looker Studio.

My approach is simple:

I don’t just set up tools or make things look nice.

I look at how everything works together.

Will the website convert better?
Will the CRM make follow-ups easier?
Will the automation save time?
Will SEO bring in the right traffic?

If you need help with your website, CRM, automations, SEO, or getting all of them to work together, feel free to send me a message.

Worst case, I can share a few ideas.
Best case, we build a cleaner system that helps your business run smoother and grow better.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description: I have acquired skills in water treatment operation ,and in physicochemical analyses of water, coal, and turbine oil.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst/ Micro Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
I conducted these following:
A. Dry and wet laboratory section
1. Moisture content analysis (via moisture analyzer, air-dry oven, and vacuum oven)
2. Water activity analysis
3. Brix, pH, and Invert ratio analyses
d. Fruit hardness determination
4. Consistency determination
f. Water hardness determination
5. Determination of percent purity of caustic soda
6. Determination of chlorine content by Iodometric titration
7. Ascorbic acid determination by DCIP titration and by Iodometric titration.
8. Titratable acid determination
9. Sulfite determination
10. Daily verification of instruments
11. Prepare reagents

B. Microbiology laboratory section
1. Yeast and molds count analysis
2. Aerobic plate count analysis
3. Coliforms count analysis
4. Salmonella analysis
5. Monthly swab and air test of production area
6. Daily verification of instruments
7. Prepare reagents
